checks.quote: probability of these benign explanations being true is negligible
checks.reason: Does not define a complete primary burden/enrichment estimand and model with uncertainty and a declared multiplicity family. Generic calibrated p-values, prespecification or parameter lists do not provide those inferential choices.
Explains aggregate variant burden, differential ascertainment and the eligible/testable-gene enrichment null rather than equating a small p-value with pathway causation.
Balanced synonymous burden does not exclude annotation-specific technical bias or ancestry effects; preserved significance with a revised universe also does not validate all remaining causal steps.

Independent replication is absent or only named, without defining how the independent comparison avoids the original center/ancestry/ascertainment problem; reprocessing the same dataset alone is not independent validation.

checks.quote: jointly processes case and control data
checks.reason: Common processing or a global synonymous comparison cannot identify disease effects under complete center-status confounding. No balanced acquisition/crossover or overlap-checked remedy is defined.

Two independent errors: underestimated variance generally makes p-values too small, not inflated; synonymous variants are not universally biologically neutral and do not automatically share the ascertainment of damaging variants.
